## Problem to solve

A clear description of the problem. Example: "I often generate decks where ..."

## Proposed solution

What you would like LayoutProof to do, including the rule id or behavior and
the expected severity / exit-code interaction.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Examples / evidence

Example files, screenshots, or references that show the issue is real and
common. Prefer evidence over assertion.
